sources.entry: Simple Machines Forum - Free, professional grade software package that allows you to set up your own online community within minutes. (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause PHP

summary.one_liner: Simple Machines Forum (SMF) is a PHP forum software package, licensed under BSD-3-Clause, for running your own online community.
summary.what_it_does: This is the development repository for Simple Machines Forum. The README describes it only briefly: it is licensed under BSD 3-clause, documentation contributions are CC-BY-SA 3, and third-party libraries and image sets carry their own licenses. Release downloads from the project's website need no extra setup, and a wiki guide is referenced. Building from the GitHub source requires Composer v2 or higher to install dependencies, with an option to include developer dependencies. The repo has two maintained branches, release-3.0 and release-2.1, and bug fixes for 3.0 are to be sent to release-3.0. The README does not list specific forum features.
use_cases: run discussion boards for a group
build a forum from source code
how_to_run: Download an official release from the project's downloads website (no extra setup needed; see the wiki guide)
Or clone the source from GitHub
notable: Development repo with separate release-3.0 and release-2.1 branches
Contributions require Developer's Certificate of Origin sign-off
Uses Composer for dependency management; vendor directory should not be edited directly
Security reports go through the project website; see SECURITY.md
caveats: Source checkout requires Composer and dependency installation; official release packages are simpler
README gives no feature list or hosting requirements beyond the Composer setup
